title: Original Prusa MINI+
description: A compact, dependable printer with the removable spring-steel sheet and original power supply. Calibrated recently and producing clean PLA and PETG parts.

title: Bambu Lab A1 mini
description: Fast desktop printer with automatic calibration and fewer than 80 print hours. Includes the stock build plate, spare nozzle and unopened sample filament.

title: Creality Ender 3 S1
description: Direct-drive printer suited to flexible filament and everyday prototyping. The bed has minor cosmetic marks but remains flat and reliable.

title: PLA Filament Colour Bundle
description: Four sealed 500 g spools in terracotta, forest green, cream and charcoal. Standard 1.75 mm diameter for most hobby printers.

title: Hakko FX-888D Soldering Station
description: Temperature-controlled soldering station with stand, brass wool and three genuine Hakko tips. Heats quickly and holds temperature steadily.

title: Arduino Sensor Starter Kit
description: An Arduino Uno-compatible board with breadboards, jumper wires, resistors and 18 labelled sensor modules. All modules were checked before packing.

title: Rigol DS1054Z Oscilloscope
description: Four-channel 50 MHz digital oscilloscope with two probes and power lead. The screen is clear; the case has light workshop scuffs.

title: Raspberry Pi 4 Workbench Set
description: Raspberry Pi 4 with 4 GB RAM, official power supply, ventilated case, 64 GB microSD card and a compact wireless keyboard.

title: Yamaha Pacifica 112V Guitar
description: Versatile sunburst electric guitar with a fresh setup, comfortable action and clean electronics. Includes a padded gig bag and strap.

title: Roland FP-10 Digital Piano
description: Weighted 88-key digital piano with pedal, music rest and folding stand. Purchased for lessons and used gently in a smoke-free home.

title: Mahogany Concert Ukulele
description: Warm-sounding solid-top concert ukulele with geared tuners. Comes with a hard case, clip-on tuner and spare string set.

title: Watercolour Studio Set
description: Winsor & Newton half-pan set with cold-press paper, masking fluid and six synthetic brushes. Only a few colours have been lightly used.

title: Cricut Maker 3 Cutting Machine
description: Smart cutting machine with fine-point blade, rotary blade, two mats and a starter pack of vinyl. Tested and reset for a new owner.

title: Tabletop Lino Printing Press
description: Compact A4 lever press for lino and small relief prints. Includes a glass inking plate, roller and a starter set of carving tools.

title: Makita Cordless Drill Set
description: Reliable 18 V drill-driver with two batteries, charger and hard case. Both batteries hold charge well for weekend projects.

title: Bosch Router with Compact Table
description: Variable-speed palm router mounted in a compact benchtop table. Fully working with cosmetic wear, fence, collets and four common bits.
